topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I was scrolling through my feed when a notification popped up. It was from Alex, one of those online buddies I chat with about everything from coffee to coding. Alex mentioned moving to a new place and tagged the local civic center in the post. My eyes widened as I recognized the landmark—it’s just a stone’s throw from my favorite café! Coincidence? Maybe not. I messaged Alex, and you wouldn't believe the spark in their reply. We’re planning to meet soon, and I can’t stop thinking about all the things we’ll do together in this city.
